# LoadingState

Pixel-grid loader with shimmer, elapsed time, and four animated variants.

## Installation

npx shadcn@latest add https://boringui.dev/r/loading-state.json

This component is primitive-agnostic — same source under both flavors.

## Source

Adapted from slev12397/beautiful-ui under the MIT License. Commercial icons were replaced and demo analytics were removed; attribution remains bundled with the component foundation.

## API Reference

 | Prop | Type | Default | Description

 | label | string | — | Accessible loading label.

 | variant | "Drive" | "Dots" | "Orbit" | "Surfer" | "Drive" | Loader presentation.

 | videoSrc | string | "/subway-surfers.mp4" | Optional media used by the Surfer example.
